profit_reward: Weekly net gain above the cash return on a common $10m starting budget, divided by $250k. Uses complete net weekly paths, including allocation costs.
sharpe_reward: Using only completed training weeks of the unchanged fixed 50/50 reference, replace the reference week with each counterfactual allocation path and measure the resulting full-training-window annualized Sharpe change. Compare this exact single-week replacement with its first-order moment derivative. This is a reward surrogate for whole-policy Sharpe, not exact global Sharpe optimization.
blend: R = profit_weight * dollar_profit_reward + (1-profit_weight) * Sharpe_reward. Scale Sharpe changes by completed training session count/252, so components represent contributions to normalized annual profit and annualized Sharpe. No arbitrary variance-penalty grid.
selection: Compare the two Sharpe reward formulations using their pure-Sharpe validation Sharpe. Freeze the winning formulation, and show its entire five-objective curve on later dates. Profit-only is shared. Save every formulation and all gamma-zero controls; no later replacement.
scope: Reward-only follow-up using gamma0.99 and 200 updates, unchanged features, state/action basis, 104-week training and 52-week minimum. Best put and straddle bandits frozen. Same seven one-budget fixed mixes, source accounting, extra resizing costs and next-close execution. No portfolio stop or fixed-control warmup. Previously researched historical dates; no manuscript edits.
